native_only_matrix.scope: native runner tests with Chromium skipped

coverage: A disposable real HTTPS upstream delivered an application/x-ndjson response through the signed runner path and the Portal session route.
The exact Portal fixture exposed network.stream, reported both network.streamAvailable and streamReady, and completed the shared SDK browser stream with ordered binary chunks.
The browser callback paused 25 ms after each accepted chunk. The bridge sent an acknowledgement only after the callback resolved and released the next chunk only after that acknowledgement.
Revocation before the first frame and revocation after a released frame failed closed without retry. The Portal session stream produced bounded start, chunk and end records.
The successful artifact records native_sdk_network_stream=true and native_portal_network_stream_session_ndjson=true. Apps PR 36 at b3a5d1b has all checks passing.
limits: This is disposable development acceptance. It does not enable production egress, registry authentication, credential provisioning or deployed firewall/DNS/proxy behavior.

The bridge remains tested with React and Node structured-clone MessagePorts in automated tests; the Chromium matrix covers the rendered iframe and real Portal shell but is not a cross-browser certification.
The public SDK and stream wire format remain experimental. This evidence does not claim a protocol freeze, D6 approval or production enablement.
